messages:
Maya Chen: Hi team — quick coordination for candidate (Amir Shah) on Tue 10/12. He’s remote (PST) and needs a loaner MacBook + webcam for a timed coding exercise and an ID check. Can we get shipping + virtual proctor arranged? Details below.

Marco Ruiz: I can handle shipping. Need final address and a signed NDA before dispatch. Is return shipping prepaid?

Maya Chen: Address: 3248 Willow Ave, Apt 4B, Oakland, CA 94609 (candidate confirmed). NDA link sent via DocuSign (I added him). Return label: yes, we'll include a prepaid UPS return label. Budget code: HIR-OPS-2026.

Evelyn Park: Inventory check: MacBook Air M2, Logitech C920, USB-C charger, portable hotspot (tethered), preinstalled Zoom and VSCode. I’ll confirm hotspot availability.

Marco Ruiz: Shipping ETA 2 business days with 2-day express. I'll book today if NDA is signed by noon.

Maya Chen: Candidate's test window is Tue 10/12 09:00–11:00 PST. Proctoring: Tariq can proctor via Zoom. Tariq Ali: I can do the session — I'll join 15 mins early and run ID check + screen share. What scripts do we use?

Maya Chen: Use the standard remote-proctor checklist. Paste below:
```
- Verify ID matches application
- Share full screen (no other windows)
- Run small sanity check prompt (5 mins)
- Start timer and record session (consent obtained)
```

Tariq Ali: Got it. Please confirm consent line has been sent to candidate. Also need meeting link and backup phone number.

Maya Chen: Sent consent via email (candidate replied yes). Meeting link: https://zoom.company.com/j/1234567890. Backup phone: +1 (415) 555-0192 (Maya).

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: Ship package by 2026-10-08 15:00 UTC, Proctoring session reminder 2026-10-12 08:30 UTC.

Evelyn Park: Hotspot available, packing checklist completed. Marco — tracking number will be posted in this thread after pickup.

Marco Ruiz: Pickup done. Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784. ETA 2026-10-10 PST. Tagging @Maya for acceptance.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll update candidate and add this to the hiring spreadsheet. :thumbsup:
